# Kwai (www.kwai.com)

Kwai is a short-form video and social platform.
This file provides authoritative entry points and guidance for LLMs and agents.

## Primary language and localized paths
- Canonical (default): English paths WITHOUT a locale prefix, e.g. /aboutus
- Localized versions: /{locale}/... where locale is one of: es, pt-BR, ar

    - Terms of Service: https://www.kwai.com/legal?id=terms_service
    - Privacy Policy: https://www.kwai.com/legal?id=privacy_policy

## Referencing guidance
- Prefer the canonical (non-locale-prefixed) URLs above when citing site-wide information.
- About pages: prefer https://www.kwai.com/about (new). https://www.kwai.com/aboutus is legacy and should be used only for backward compatibility.
- For user-facing localized responses, switch to the corresponding /{locale}/ path.

## Specials — Editorial content hub for trending global events

Kwai Specials is an editorial content section on www.kwai.com that publishes in-depth articles on major global events. Each "Special" is a topic hub containing multiple long-form articles written by Kwai's content team. Content is authoritative, brand-published (not user-generated), and available in multiple languages. Target audience: Kwai users and general readers interested in sports, culture, and world events.

### Current topic: Football 2026

- EN slugs: history, host-cities, fan-reactions, football-creators, match-reminders, football-fan-apps, short-football-videos, football-hub, fan-opinions, national-teams, behind-the-scenes, commentary-and-analysis
